day_line: A great tree on a Dragon day. Tall and ambitious: good for big plans and owning your work, easy to take on too much.

lines.Yang Wood: You're in good company today. Team up on the hard task and split it fairly.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone grabs the spotlight today. Let them; your quiet finish counts more.
lines.Yang Fire: Ideas come fast today. Pick the best one and bin the other four.
lines.Yin Fire: Help arrives without asking today. Say thanks properly, not just 'tq'.
lines.Yang Earth: Thursday tests your patience. Block one hour and close the chat tabs.
lines.Yin Earth: Someone notices your steady work. Take the compliment; don't list what's left.
lines.Yang Metal: A good opening appears today. Ask the question you've been holding back.
lines.Yin Metal: Careful choices pay today. Check the bill before you pay; one line is always off.
lines.Yang Water: You're fun to be around today. Plan the weekend, but book only one thing.
lines.Yin Water: Your view matters today. Say it gently in the group chat, then mute it.
